Game Overview

At its heart, Cube Land is a jumping game about guide your agile cube through a mesmerizing landscape of platforms and obstacles using simple tap mechanics. Perfect your timing to master increasingly complex levels. With each jump, face thrilling challenges and set impressive high scores in this addictive, fast-paced adventure that keeps you reaching for more.

How to Play

Cube Land keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide your agile cube through a mesmerizing landscape of platforms and obstacles using simple tap mechanics. Perfect your timing to master increasingly complex levels. With each jump, face thrilling challenges and set impressive high scores in this addictive, fast-paced adventure that keeps you reaching for more.
